title: Bettis lab, naval nuclear power and western PA UFO sightings

tellings.quote: Bettis research lab up in Pittsburgh and they were the first people to develop nuclear power for the Navy and that was in the 50s and you get into Kexsburg and all the UFO sightings in the western PA region.

plain: In the 1950s a research lab in Pittsburgh called Bettis became the first to develop nuclear power for the US Navy, and western Pennsylvania later saw many UFO sightings, among them the case at a place called Kexsburg. A researcher named Dylan Borland puts the two side by side on Jesse Michels's show, without naming a source, and suggests the nuclear work and the sightings in the same region may be linked.
